title: Peter and Isabel Malkin Professor of Public Policy, Emeritus
affiliation: Peter and Isabel Malkin Professor of Public Policy, Emeritus
bio: Robert D. Putnam is the Malkin Research Professor of Public Policy at Harvard University, having retired from active teaching in May 2018. Raised in a small town in Ohio, he was educated at Swarthmore, Oxford, and Yale. He is a member of the National Academy of Sciences, a Fellow of the British Academy, and past president of the American Political Science Association.
